policy.record_first: Future full real-paper audits must become source-backed recorded cases; named benchmark-only sources remain explicitly lower provenance until promoted.
policy.benchmark_boundary: A public source used only in a benchmark is preserved as benchmark-source evidence and is not described as a full replay.
policy.legacy_boundary: Legacy fixtures preserve earlier regression evidence but do not claim missing historical source metadata.
policy.counting_boundary: Multiple benchmark or replay surfaces on one source do not count as multiple independent sources.

entries.title: Ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia, non-specific colitis, and pervasive developmental disorder in children
Ultrahigh power and energy density in partially ordered lithium-ion cathode materials

current_judgment.main_boundary: Reported energy/rate performance is direct; the broad material-design mechanism and transfer beyond tested compositions require more than headline performance.

entries.title: Dry Electrode Architecture Design for Pushing Energy Density Limits at Cell Level

current_judgment.main_boundary: A preprint can still earn sufficient support for its tested electrode/cell result; cell-level technology generality remains bounded by tested architectures and conditions.

entries.title: Layered-rocksalt intergrown cathode for high-capacity zero-strain battery operation

current_judgment.main_boundary: The tested zero-strain/high-capacity behavior is well supported; a general design principle across the wider composition space remains a broader inference.

entries.title: Photochemically driven solid electrolyte interphase for extremely fast-charging lithium-ion batteries

current_judgment.main_boundary: Fast-charge performance in the tested graphite full cell is direct; attributing the whole improvement to a LiF-rich SEI and projecting to practical deployments adds mechanistic/generalization reach.

entries.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Effects of the BESMILE-HF Program on Chronic Heart Failure Patients: A Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial

current_judgment.main_boundary: Feasibility/adherence is directly supported; clinical efficacy is not established by an 18-person pilot and the paper itself calls for a larger, longer trial.

entries.title: Effects of a Narrative-Based Psychoeducational Intervention to Prepare Patients for Responding to Acute Myocardial Infarction: A Randomized Clinical Trial

current_judgment.main_boundary: The intervention improves measured care-seeking intention/attitudes; actual emergency care-seeking behavior and clinical outcomes are stronger downstream claims.

entries.title: Effect of a Multicomponent Intervention Delivered on a Web-Based Platform on Hypertension Control: A Cluster Randomized Clinical Trial

current_judgment.main_boundary: Improved BP control in the studied communities is direct; broad public-health transfer across diverse populations extends beyond the enrolled clusters.

entries.title: A scalable method for preparing Cu electrocatalysts that convert CO2 into C2+ products

current_judgment.main_boundary: C2+ Faradaic efficiency and preparation performance are direct; identifying defect density/low roughness as the required active causal explanation is a stronger mechanistic claim.

entries.title: Pitfalls in identifying active catalyst species

current_judgment.main_boundary: As a critique of another article, its strongest conclusions structurally depend on the target paper and characterization logic; venue prestige does not remove that external dependency.

entries.title: Iodide-mediated Cu catalyst restructuring during CO2 electroreduction

current_judgment.main_boundary: Observed restructuring and selectivity shifts are direct; assigning a unique active species/pathway from dynamic morphology remains mechanistically harder.

entries.title: Experimental and numerical investigation of NO oxidation on Pt/Al2O3- and NOx storage on Pt/BaO/Al2O3-catalysts

current_judgment.main_boundary: Measured spatial/temporal NO behavior is direct; fitted kinetic mechanisms reproduce the data but are not equivalent to independently validated unique mechanisms.

entries.title: Assessing the observed impact of anthropogenic climate change

current_judgment.main_boundary: Attribution is stronger for temperature-related impacts than precipitation impacts; the paper itself reports that asymmetry, so a uniform all-impact conclusion would overreach.

entries.title: Surface Infrared Forcing as a Primary Driver of Contemporary Global Warming: A Synthesis of Biophysical, Spectral, and Land-Use Evidence

current_judgment.main_boundary: Most support is imported from heterogeneous cited literature; the synthesis does not independently establish the strong claim that land-surface infrared forcing is a co-primary global warming driver.

entries.title: Anthropogenic climate change has driven over 5 million km2 of drylands towards desertification

current_judgment.main_boundary: The modeled attribution within the study's dryland framework is supportable; extrapolating to all desertification mechanisms or regions is broader.

entries.title: Attribution of 2020 hurricane season extreme rainfall to human-induced climate change

current_judgment.main_boundary: The counterfactual hindcast supports a bounded attribution of 2020-season extreme rainfall; it does not by itself establish every hurricane hazard or future-season effect.

entries.title: Accelerated modern human-induced species losses: Entering the sixth mass extinction

current_judgment.main_boundary: Observed extinction rates under conservative background assumptions are directly analyzable; the broader 'sixth mass extinction' label adds scale and definitional reach.

entries.title: Ecoacoustics as a novel tool for assessing pond restoration success: Results of a pilot study
entries.venue: Aquatic Conservation: Marine and Freshwater Ecosystems

current_judgment.main_boundary: Pilot soundscape differences may be useful locally, but treating acoustic indices as a general biodiversity/restoration proxy requires broader validation.

entries.title: Microclimatic Warming Leads to a Decrease in Species and Growth Form Diversity: Insights From a Tropical Alpine Grassland

current_judgment.main_boundary: Seven-year OTC effects in the study site are direct; long-term transition to shrub-dominated ecosystems is explicitly a further projection.

entries.title: Impact of round goby on native invertebrate communities - An experimental field study
entries.venue: Journal of Experimental Marine Biology and Ecology

current_judgment.main_boundary: The 12-cage local predation effect is direct; claims about trophic cascades, ecosystem functioning, and other invaded areas are downstream generalization.

entries.title: Experimental Estimates of Education Production Functions

current_judgment.main_boundary: Random assignment supports class-size effects in Project STAR; later-year/subgroup/general population claims depend on attrition, transitions, and external generality.

entries.title: Learning How to Order Imaging Tests and Make Subsequent Clinical Decisions: a Randomized Study of the Effectiveness of a Virtual Learning Environment for Medical Students

current_judgment.main_boundary: The blinded OSCE difference supports this course/cohort; 26 students cannot establish broad curricular generality.

entries.title: Flipped learning enhances non-technical skill performance in simulation-based education: a randomised controlled trial

current_judgment.main_boundary: Measured NTS performance in this training context improved; transfer to clinical behavior or other educational settings is broader.

entries.title: Not just words! Effects of a light-touch randomized encouragement intervention on students' exam grades, self-efficacy, motivation, and test anxiety

current_judgment.main_boundary: The null average exam-grade effect is informative; secondary self-efficacy patterns should not be laundered into a demonstrated achievement mechanism.

entries.title: Does a stacked bid side actually mean support?

current_judgment.main_boundary: The five-market directional association can be supported despite blog status; the article's own return calculation shows it does not establish a tradeable strategy after costs.

entries.title: Queue Imbalance as a One-Tick-Ahead Price Predictor in a Limit Order Book

current_judgment.main_boundary: One-tick predictive association is supported in the selected stocks; economic/actionable trading value and market-wide persistence are different claims.

entries.title: Deep Limit Order Book Forecasting

current_judgment.main_boundary: Forecast metrics can be strong while actionable trading performance remains weak; the paper itself explicitly separates those endpoints.

entries.title: Why Johnny Can't Encrypt: A Usability Evaluation of PGP 5.0

current_judgment.main_boundary: The lab study strongly supports usability failure for the tested novices/tasks; 'most computer users' and general security-interface theory extend beyond the small case study.

entries.title: Adaptive User Interface Generation Through Reinforcement Learning: A Data-Driven Approach to Personalization and Optimization

current_judgment.main_boundary: Dataset-level CTR/retention evaluation may support bounded benchmark performance; claims about real users and continuously personalized interfaces require real deployment/user evidence.

entries.title: Adapting User Interfaces with Model-based Reinforcement Learning
entries.access: abstract/metadata plus public author copies may be available

current_judgment.main_boundary: The adaptive-menu comparison supports tested policies; broad claims about adaptive interfaces across tasks/users require external validation.

entries.title: The Image of the Interface: How People Use Landmarks to Develop Spatial Memory of Commands in Graphical Interfaces

current_judgment.main_boundary: Observed reliance on landmarks in four GUIs is direct; prescriptive guidelines for future GUI memorability are broader design generalization.

entries.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

current_judgment.main_boundary: Eleven-task benchmark gains are direct; the label 'language understanding' and general superiority outside tested tasks/models have broader construct/generality reach.

entries.title: Let's talk about LLM evaluation

current_judgment.main_boundary: The article contains useful evaluation heuristics and examples, but many prescriptions are experiential/synthetic and are not organized as a single paper-local empirical evidence chain.

entries.title: Are All the Datasets in Benchmark Necessary? A Pilot Study of Dataset Evaluation for Text Classification

current_judgment.main_boundary: Discrimination differences among 9 datasets/36 systems are direct; predicting benchmark usefulness for unseen datasets is explicitly preliminary.

entries.title: StructEval: Deepen and Broaden Large Language Model Assessment via Structured Evaluation

current_judgment.main_boundary: Results on three benchmarks can support local robustness/consistency; broad resistance to contamination/bias across LLM evaluation regimes is a wider claim.

entries.title: The BErkeley Atmospheric CO2 Observation Network: field calibration and evaluation of low-cost air quality sensors

current_judgment.main_boundary: Field co-location/calibration performance is direct; transfer to new sensor lots, environments, and long-term drift regimes needs independent validation.

entries.title: A temporal deep learning framework for calibration of low-cost air quality sensors

current_judgment.main_boundary: Unseen temporal-window results and regulatory uncertainty checks support local calibration performance; one network does not establish general compliance across devices/cities.

entries.title: Calibration of SO2 and NO2 Electrochemical Sensors via a Training and Testing Method in an Industrial Coastal Environment

current_judgment.main_boundary: Relocated field test supports the studied environment; 'replicable in similar environments' remains conditional on temperature/humidity and sensor-context transfer.

entries.title: Development and Calibration of a Low-Cost, Piezoelectric Rainfall Sensor through Machine Learning

current_judgment.main_boundary: Co-located prototype calibration supports feasibility in tested rainfall events; operational-network accuracy and environmental transfer require broader validation.
